A young Mickey navigates through the dense Texas humidity of the 70's and out onto the porch every single time his Granddaddy calls him, where he's presented with the heirloom recipe for life, love, and manhood. But all the logic and insight in the world cannot prepare him to operate correctly in the presence of a wonderfully beautiful little girl who moves in just behind his rear fence. title: Brand meaning management
summary: Establishing, expanding and leveraging brand meaning is critically important yet exceedingly complex. Successful brand meaning management is foundational to both brand differentiation and to outcomes like brand identification and brand attachment. Yet, managing this meaning over time is complex. Noted contributors to this special issue add new insights to this complex domain. A group of papers lend insight into the myriad entities involved in the meaning making process itself, such as marketers, celebrities, brand users, and the broader culture in which consumers live. A second set emphasizes the critical impact that brand meaning has on consumers and brands themselvesâoutcomes that include brand identification and attachment, social relationship management, and brand evangelism. The final set addresses when and how brand transgressions can threaten these outcomes, and what brands must do to recover from lost or tainted meanings. The volume co-editors provide an overview of the chapters and identify future research issues on brand meaning management in B2B (vs. B2C) markets, and how multi-product firms manage the collective set of meanings that comprise their brand portfolio.

summary:
“ Tok Tam” revolves around a group of animal who live in a small Malaysian Village. They lives in a barn led by an old wise Turkey, Tok Tam. Along with him there are the family of Jaguh the rooster, Bu the hen and their chicks, Chick and Chack. There are also Misai the cat, Mak Boo the cow, Pak Bekk the goat, Cik Lenggang the duck and Cik Siti the mouse. In the series, Tok Tam will tell moral stories fill with message and values for the viewers. Among the stories that will be told are.The Rabbit and The Tortoise, The Greedy Lion, The Wise Mousedeer and others.

In every episode, you will also be entertained with folk song from the region. The song will be presented with dances and sketches perform by the animation characters from the series. The series will also potray advice and guidance in a special segment with Tok Tam on safety measures such as how to cross the roads, handling electrical appliances and others. Meanwhile, Professor Jampuk the Owl and friends, will teach alphabets A to Z and introduce shapes and colors. Jaguh and Family will visit interesting holiday location in a special segment, which will blend the animation characters of Jaguh and family with actual visual from the places
